sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: As the French Canadian superstar returns for her first concerts since she was diagnosed with stiff person syndrome, we count down the best of an unabashedly romantic catalogue. Wind machines at the ready! When Céline Dion’s era as a foolproof hitmaker ended, she seemed weirdly liberated and more willing to take risks. Witness the video for Ashes : an impressively atmospheric ballad from the soundtrack to Deadpool 2 , in which she gently mocks her own image in the company of Ryan Reynolds, in character as the antihero. Continue reading...
